purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The municipal cadastre and geoprocessing system is confirmed. The public map route could not be inspected to a safe feature schema; no parcel polygon was requested or retained.
registryAssessment: Campo Grande’s municipal government says SIMGEO integrates the municipal Cadastro Territorial Multifinalitário (CTM), its city data are georeferenced and made available to citizens, and the system supports the city’s property/infrastructure geographic information. This confirms a municipal territorial-cadastre function, but does not prove public access to a parcel-only geometry layer.
